name: segmented
title: Segmented control
description: A segmented control, like an iOS segmented control or a toggle group with one value: the thumb moves in position and width on one spring, and a new choice made mid flight continues from its current speed. A WAI-ARIA radio group with arrow keys, Home, End and one tab stop.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Segmented control from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Segmented, SegmentedItem } from "@/components/ui/motion-segmented".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-segmented.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createSegmented on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/segmented/segmented.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#segmented
